title: DecisionQualityAuditOutput
description: Output of a decision quality audit. Provides a composite quality score with dimensional breakdown, identified gaps and assumptions, accountability mapping, and actionable improvement recommendations.

executive_summary.description: 2-4 sentence overview of the decision quality audit findings: what was decided (or not), how well, and the single biggest gap.

decision_surface.description: Concise statement of the decision or decision area being audited, as extracted from the transcript.

decision_status.description: Whether a clear decision was reached, a tentative direction was set, or no decision was made.

decision_quality_score.description: Composite decision quality score (0-100). Weighted average of the score_breakdown dimensions.

score_breakdown.description: Dimensional scores contributing to the composite decision_quality_score.

strengths.description: What the group did well in this decision process.

gaps.description: Decision quality gaps identified in the transcript. Each gap includes evidence, impact level, and a suggested fix.

assumptions.description: Assumptions underpinning the decision — both explicit and implicit. Each includes validation status and a fast test.

alternatives_missing.description: Alternatives or options that were not discussed but should have been considered.

risks_underweighted.description: Risks that were mentioned but insufficiently explored, or not mentioned at all.

accountability_snapshot.description: Who owns what coming out of this decision, with confidence levels and proof artifacts.

decision_hygiene_upgrades_next_meeting.description: Process improvements the group should adopt in the next meeting to improve decision quality.

single_most_important_upgrade.description: The single highest-leverage improvement to decision quality, with owner and deadline.

citations.description: Verbatim transcript quotes supporting the audit findings.

metadata.description: Processing metadata including mode used and generation timestamp.

clarity_of_decision.description: How clearly the decision was articulated and understood by participants.

evidence_quality.description: Quality and relevance of data, analysis, and evidence cited during discussion.

alternatives_considered.description: Breadth and depth of alternative options explored before deciding.

risk_assessment_quality.description: How thoroughly risks were identified, weighted, and mitigated.

ownership_and_accountability.description: Clarity of who owns the decision, next steps, and follow-through mechanisms.

reversibility_and_checkpoints.description: Whether the group established checkpoints, kill criteria, or reversal plans.

speaker.description: Name of the person who said this.

approximate_location.description: Where in the transcript this quote appears (e.g. 'opening remarks', 'mid-discussion').

gap.description: Description of the decision quality gap.

why_it_matters.description: Why this gap is consequential for the decision.

impact_level.description: Severity of the gap's impact on decision quality.

evidence.description: Transcript evidence supporting this gap identification.

fix.description: Recommended action to close this gap.

explicit_or_implicit.description: Whether this assumption was stated aloud or inferred from context.

validated.description: Whether this assumption has been validated with evidence.

how_to_test_fast.description: A quick, low-cost way to validate or invalidate this assumption.

commitment.description: What they committed to deliver or do.

due_or_window.description: When this is due or the expected delivery window.

proof_artifact.description: Tangible output that proves this commitment was fulfilled.

confidence.description: Confidence that this commitment will be met on time.

upgrade.description: The single most impactful improvement to decision quality.

why.description: Why this upgrade matters more than others.

success_signal.description: How to know this upgrade has been successfully implemented.

speaker.description: Name of the person who said this.

approximate_location.description: Where in the transcript this quote appears.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime when this output was generated.
